capabilities: Copy selected cells or ranges to the clipboard as tabbed text, HTML, Markdown table, or CSV
Copy cell formulas and formatting separately or together
Select a range with a floating reference bar (e.g. A2:D7) and drag or arrow adjustments
Open a copy panel via long-press on touch devices, right-click on desktop, or the command palette
Copy a single cell quickly with double tap, Ctrl+click, or Cmd+click
extras: README is written in Spanish with brief English section headers; the copy panel only works in Sheet Plus full-sheet view, not embedded sheets; includes a touch-selection diagnostic mode for mobile troubleshooting; states all processing is local with no network or credentials; Ko-fi donations are voluntary and unlock nothing.
intentEvidence: Complemento para copiar celdas y rangos de Sheet Plus en Obsidian.
problem: Sheet Plus spreadsheets in Obsidian lack a way to copy cell content, formulas, or formatting out to apps like Excel, WPS, or Google Sheets.
